item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Piotr Sakowski (PioterekS) — a developer who prefers building practical tools over leaving ideas in notebooks. I split my time between crafting web utilities, integrating data feeds, and maintaining the small projects that power this site.

✨ Linux Rules the World ✨
My personal credo since always.

Tooling & Stack

  • Languages: I use Python for data wrangling and automation, JavaScript/React for UI glue, and Bash scripts when Linux nostalgia from the 90s kicks in or when a CI/CD pipeline needs to be done.
  • Frameworks and Libraries: JavaScript, React, React Native, Vite, Tailwind.
  • Data Work: SQLite and Postgres for persistence, a pile of APIs, and custom cache layers when latency matters. I also know Oracle very well.

You can browse more experiments and utilities in my GitHub repos at https://github.com/piotereks — everything from ESP dictionary helpers to VCF generators lives there.

Install bookmarklets

This page shows how to install a browser bookmarklet so you can inject custom tools into any web page.

Use the button below to drag a new bookmark into your bookmarks bar, or copy the bookmark URL manually.

ESP Dict bookmarklet

Drag this button to your bookmarks bar to install the dictionary hook loader:

es-dict

How to use

  1. Make sure your browser shows the bookmarks bar.
  2. Drag the button above to the bookmarks bar.
  3. Visit any page where you want to use the bookmarklet.
  4. Click the new bookmark to load the dictionary hook.

item.title: Privacy
item.description:
SYI runs as a small, static site powered by Hugo. The goal is to keep tracking light while still understanding if the tools stay online. This page explains what data the site touches and how you can ask questions.

Cookies and Ads

  • Google AdSense scripts may load on selected pages. AdSense can set cookies or similar storage to measure impressions, detect fraud, and personalize or contextualize ads. Visit https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads to learn how Google uses data and how to manage your ad settings.
  • AdSense-enabled pages may display “Ad” labels or similar indicators to help you identify them.
  • I do not run additional trackers or sell any behavioral data. If your browser blocks third-party cookies, the apps will still work.

Application Data

  • Each tool runs client-side. Inputs such as search terms, wildcard patterns, or contact data stay in your browser. They are not stored on my servers.
  • No data is sent to or stored on my servers unless explicitly stated, such as when external APIs are used.
  • Some projects fetch external APIs (for example, parking sensors or dictionary endpoints). Requests go directly from your browser to those providers; their own privacy policies apply.
  • Parking Data: If you use the parking tool, the app may send parking availability data from your device to an external API to improve the accuracy of parking information. This data is anonymized and does not include any personally identifiable information.

Logs and Diagnostics

  • Basic server logs capture IP address, user agent, requested path, and timestamp. I retain logs for roughly 30 days to debug outages and abuse.
  • During updates I may enable temporary diagnostics (like the /diag endpoint) to confirm that ads or scripts load. These diagnostics focus on runtime state, not personal profiles, and are purged after testing.
  • If diagnostics are enabled, a notification will be displayed on the site to inform users.

Data Accuracy Disclaimer

  • Sensor data, and dictionaries records come from third parties. I cannot guarantee accuracy or freshness. Treat the results as informational only and verify before making important decisions.
  • For example, parking data is sourced from Green Day and University APIs, and dictionary data is sourced from RAE and WordReference.

Contact and Requests

  • Email privacy questions or removal requests to piotereks@duck.com.
  • I aim to respond to inquiries within 5 business days.

I may update this page when I add new integrations or analytics.
